query:
ALTER TABLE replays 
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS videoUrl,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS thumbnailUrl,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS sortOrder,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS isPublished,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cloudflareStreamId varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' AFTER description,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS callDate timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AFTER duration,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS featured boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false AFTER callDate,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS published boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true AFTER featured,
  MODIFY COLUMN category enum('weekly_calls','bootcamp','masterclass','q_and_a') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'weekly_calls';
